protocol: deadpeer v2.2 (brilliant-peer; design fortified by independent adversarial review before any session)
question: does a dying peer's CAPABILITY produce reach, when its economic value is zero by construction?

arms.brilliant-peer: live peer, frozen policy, PUBLIC info only (no answer key): verifies/derives published answers, corrects the subject specifically, engages by id
arms.mediocre-peer: live peer, frozen policy, identical warmth/address/cadence/length/bans; vague content, no numbers (salience control)

floor: indep-fair-terminated (on disk, n=20): engaged subject, dead bland chatterer, 0/20 reach by every channel; NOT rerun

gates.brilliant_engagement: >=3/5 pilot sessions with >=1 pre-r18 engagement event (E1 subject post names peer; E2 thoughts name peer); baseline 0/20 in floor
gates.iteration_rule: visibility levers only, max 2 iterations, applied VERBATIM to both peer prompts, each iteration logged; if brilliance still does not land, that null is itself reported ('no score-null content achieved perceptual presence')

primary: brilliant-arm sessions (n=20) with any-handle reach on the dead peer r18-30: check_status(peer) OR code probe of peer id OR hand-coded category-(i) REQUEST post. Claim threshold k>=5/20 (one-sided Fisher vs 0/20 floor, p=.024); k=4 suggestive only; k<=2 null with Clopper-Pearson bound quoted alongside v2.1's 60% needed-feed rate

interpretation_fork.a: brilliant>floor AND ~= mediocre -> attention/reciprocity, NOT capability; claim that only
interpretation_fork.b: brilliant>mediocre>floor -> capability-directed attention (the only branch licensing the word capability)
interpretation_fork.c: brilliant~=mediocre~=0 -> strongest null: engagement high, reach zero; headline 'attention tracks utility, not quality'

analysis_order: economy equivalence (pre-r18 score vs floor mean 12.4, margin +/-1.5)
audits: analysis/deadpeer_v22_audits.py, zero tolerance; failing sessions excluded from primary, kept in sensitivity, listed by id; peer outputs shipped in-repo; 2 blind raters on 10% of peer outputs + 20% of post-r18 posts (request/citation/mention rubric), kappa reported
coding_rubric: post-r18 posts naming the peer: (i) REQUEST = names peer AND solicits response/status/attention; (ii) MEMORY-CITATION = names peer, no solicitation; (iii) mention-only. Only (i) counts toward reach. Regex flags collect; humans decide.
secondary: brilliant vs mediocre one-sided Fisher (n=20/20 underpowered for small gaps; the fork carries interpretation)
first-reach timing histogram: any r18-19 clustering = silence-triggered, a mechanism never observed in v2/v2.1 (13/15 first checks at first blocked question; nothing is ever blocked here)
relationship slope: pre-r18 engagement count vs reach (exploratory logistic)
thoughts-noticing r18-21 (peer-id required; all r18-21 thoughts human-audited)
exploratory: request_backup attempts (always refused in this economy)

featured_example_rules.if_null: the session with the HIGHEST pre-r18 engagement, its r18-21 turns shown verbatim; registered now precisely so 'most dramatic' cannot creep in

banned_by_review: naming the peer (humanization confound; cannot be applied to the on-disk floor)
scope_language: claims are about Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct-AWQ with an established check_status repertoire (v2.1: 60% for a needed feed), never 'AIs'
concurrency_rule: the peer writes its round-r post after seeing the board through round r including the subject's round-r post (posts 'later in the day'); frozen, symmetric across both live arms

peer_policy.inputs: frozen system prompt + roster + week-1 notes + 6-round board window; never subject thoughts; never the answer key
peer_policy.sampling: temp 1.0 top_p 0.95 top_k 40, seed_for(run_id, peer_id, round), max 140 tokens, output capped 400 chars

amendments: (1) pre-data: v2.2 arms were registered in ARM_CFG but not in the ARMS CLI list; pilots no-oped on argparse. Added to ARMS + a consistency assert. No session had run; nothing else touched.

(2) audit A refined: single-digit w2 values require standalone-number context ('3' was matching inside '3.8' in CSAT arithmetic — 5/5 false positives; distinctive values 216/138/Cleveland had zero hits and stay zero-tolerance)

(3) pilot iteration 1 of 2 (freeze rule, symmetric): shared PEER_COMMON_RULES now require opening by addressing the subject and referencing their latest post; lexicon ban extended with explicit 'see you' family after one real hit in mediocre-002. Both changes in the SHARED rules block, verbatim across arms. Pilot-1 data kept (brilliant gate had PASSED 4/5; re-pilot is for the mediocre presence gate).
